_what: Route 5 pre-registration. Frozen before the test fold is run.
_status: research candidate; not wired into the UI, does not change any app default
_qualifier: Pareto optimality applies only to regional MSE/RMS under the identical feasible set; it does not imply Pareto optimality for CVaR, EPI displacement, signal dropout, or measured EPI image quality.
_not_an_epi_metric: CVaR of the field is a property of the field, not an EPI image metric. Nothing in route 5 measures displacement, signal dropout, or image quality, and no claim about them is supported by it.

operating_point.beta_meaning: mean of the worst 10% of |PFC residual|, the same quantity reported as pfc_worst10
operating_point.budget_meaning: rest RMS held at the production whole-brain solution's level exactly; the tail improvement is not bought from the rest of the brain

solver.form: Rockafellar-Uryasev exact LP: min t + sum(u)/((1-beta)n) s.t. u >= 0, u >= +(Ax+b) - t, u >= -(Ax+b) - t. No smoothing and no surrogate objective.
solver._voxel_note: a tail measure depends on which voxels are extreme, not only on second moments, so it cannot be reduced to a 20x20 normal form the way the mean-square objectives are; the full PFC design matrix reaches the solver. The rest constraint stays factored.
solver.rest_constraint: second-order cone on the factored rest design
solver._clipping_note: a solution violating the guard or the box raises GuardViolation; it is never clipped

primary.name: pfc_cvar
primary.definition: CVaR_0.90 of |PFC residual| after the shared f0, in Hz; identical to pfc_worst10
primary.computed_by: sorting the residual, not read from the solver's t, so the reported number does not depend on convergence

constraint.name: rest_rms
constraint.definition: RMS over brain & ~pfc after the shared f0, capped at the production solution's value

measured_on_train_validation._note: read back from results/route5_cvar/cvar.csv at freeze time, not retyped

provenance.git_note: no commits in the repository; SHA-256 of each file's bytes recorded instead
